paper_title: Direct Search for Dark Matter Axions Excluding ALP Cogenesis in the 63-67 micro-eV Range, with The ORGAN Experiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of FIG. 4
notes: ORGAN Phase 1a haloscope search (UWA, Perth) scanning 15.28-16.23 GHz (63.2-67.1 ueV) with a TM010 copper cavity in an 11.5 T magnet. Abstract quotes a representative exclusion of g_agamma >= 3e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL over the mass range, assuming axions are all of the local DM (rho = 0.45 GeV/cm^3). The actual limit (Fig. 4) is frequency-dependent with gaps at mode-mixing regions (15.58-15.61, 15.65-15.69, 15.96-16.15 GHz), but no numerical table is provided, so the quoted flat value is encoded as a two-point horizontal bound over the stated validity range. Excludes ALP-cogenesis model over most of the range.
